versions.content: If a SdClientService is set to SD_CLIENT_SERVICE_RELEASED (via Sd_ClientServiceSetState() or Sd_ServiceGroupStop() ) while one or more of its Eventgroups are still requested ( SD_CONSUMED_EVENTGROUP_REQUESTED ) the Service Discovery shall interpret this the same way as these Eventgroups were called with SD_CONSUMED_EVENTGROUP_RELEASED first.

If a SdClientService is set to SD_CLIENT_SERVICE_RELEASED (via Sd_ClientServiceSetState() or Sd_ServiceGroupStop() ) while one or more of its Eventgroups are still requested ( SD_CONSUMED_EVENTGROUP_REQUESTED ) the Service Discovery shall interpret this the same way as these Eventgroups were called with SD_CONSUMED_EVENTGROUP_RELEASED first.
